# `api.jobs.rates.select_quote`

> `POST /job/{jobDisplayId}/rates/select-quote` — ACPortal

**Python**

```python
api.jobs.rates.select_quote(job_display_id: int, **kwargs: Any) -> SelectedQuoteResult
```

**CLI**

```bash
ab jobs rates select_quote <job_display_id> [--body ...]
```

Preview a carrier quote from ``rates_key`` without saving a shipping record.

Persist selection with ``jobs.freight_providers.select_rate_quote``.

## Request body — `SelectQuoteRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `jobModifiedDate` | `Optional[datetime]` | no | Last observed job modification timestamp for optimistic concurrency. |
| `forceUpdate` | `bool` | no | Allow an overwrite-policy conflict override; refresh-policy conflicts still require a fresh read. |
| `ratesKey` | `str` | yes | Opaque key returned by the rate request; required when selecting a quote. |
| `carrierCode` | `str` | yes | Carrier code from the chosen provider in the matching rate response. |
| `carrierAccountId` | `Optional[int]` | no | Carrier account id. |
| `active` | `Optional[bool]` | no | Active. |
| `pickupAgentId` | `Optional[UUID]` | no | Pickup agent id. |

## Response

Returns `SelectedQuoteResult`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `success` | `Optional[bool]` | no | Success. |
| `errorMessage` | `Optional[str]` | no | Error message. |
| `jobModifiedDate` | `Optional[datetime]` | no | Last observed job modification timestamp for optimistic concurrency. |
| `transportationQuote` | `Optional[TransportationQuoteResult]` | no | Transportation quote. |
